Name: Little Nook Farm
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
This is the farm that was designed for my 1 crop challenge farm, only without the 1 crop limitation. While small, there is still space for 200+ crops. You can fit a barn and coop in the available space if you're wanting less farm space.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332435.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Roughly ~200 tillable spaces[/*]
[*]A cozy little atmosphere[/*]
[*]Of course there's a waterfall. I'm not a monster.[/*]
[*]Adds a new farm. This is not a farm replacer.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332579.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE) and most other major content mods.[/*]
[*]Compatible with most recolor mods[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip this mod's folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI and select the Little Nook farm when starting a new game. This adds a new farm and is *NOT* a replacer[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Note: This is intended to be a small lightweight farm. There is minimal forage or fish available from the farm purely due to space[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332750.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Description separators made via https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/[/*]
[/list]
